def _format_path(t_path):
    # t_path is a sequence of (op, arg) pairs flattened: op0, arg0, op1, arg1, ...
    # Check if there are any 'P' (plain path) operations
    ops = t_path[0::2]
    args = t_path[1::2]
    
    has_p = 'P' in ops
    
    if not has_p:
        # All T-style operations, render as T expression
        return _format_t(t_path)
    
    # Mixed or all-P: render as Path(...)
    # Group consecutive T-ops and P-ops into segments
    segments = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(ops):
        if ops[i] == 'P':
            segments.append(bbrepr(args[i]))
            i += 1
        else:
            # Collect consecutive non-P ops into a T expression
            j = i
            while j < len(ops) and ops[j] != 'P':
                j += 1
            t_sub_path = []
            for k in range(i, j):
                t_sub_path.extend([ops[k], args[k]])
            segments.append(_format_t(tuple(t_sub_path)))
            i = j
    
    return 'Path(' + ', '.join(segments) + ')'
